steps.text: 1. The Tourist opens the Explore page (/).

2. The system shows the search box, the [Tours | Places] tabs, the city picker ("Featured destinations" list), the [List | Map] toggle and the "Continue listening" (recently opened tours), "Near you" and "Popular" sections.
3. The Tourist enters a keyword or opens the "Filters" panel (City, Original language, Tour type) and taps "Show results"; "Clear filters" restores the defaults. A1, A2.
4. The system searches automatically 300 ms after the last keystroke.
5. The system (Tour) returns only tours in the Public status with the number of places, duration and rating; results are paginated with a numbered pager. E1, E2.

exceptions.text: E1. No results → "No matching tours found" (or "places") with a "Clear search & filters" button.
E2. No network → "Network connection lost"; downloaded tours can still be opened in Account → Downloaded tours (UC#03).

steps.text: 7. The system shows the details: cover image, description, route map, place list, author (UC#18), ratings (UC#05), the "Human voice" / "Device voice" label. E3.

exceptions.text: E3. The tour is no longer public or does not exist → 404 "The tour is no longer available".

steps.text: 8. The Tourist chooses a listening language. A3.
9. The system returns the tour content in the chosen language.
10. The Tourist taps "Preview" or "Start the tour". A4, A5.

exceptions.text: E4. Choosing "Near me" without location permission → asks for location permission and keeps the previous sort order.

steps: A1. Sort results: the Tours tab has Popular, Top rated, Newest, Near me; the Places tab has Recently updated, Near me (needs location permission). E4.
A2. View results on the map: choose "Map"; each tour / place is a numbered pin; tap a pin to see a summary card and open the details. Results without a location show no pin.

A3. Change language: only languages that every place of the tour has a translation for are shown; if the author enabled automatic translation for tourists, another language can be requested (UC#04 A7).
A4. Places tab: find individual stops of public tours to view them or add them to an itinerary (UC#07).
A5. Other actions on the detail page: download the tour offline (UC#03), report a violation (UC#06), view / write a rating (UC#05), open the author page and follow (UC#18).
